entries.reason: The full notice concerns author/source attribution data, not money or only a list of names. Both save and restore failures are covered; existing saved data were retained and retry is requested.

entries.original_xml_text: "Zbog ovih podataka o autorima i izvorima slika, količina podataka u crtežu bila bi prevelika za vraćanje. Vaš prethodni crtež i podaci o autorima i izvorima slika su zadržani."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Zbog ovih podataka o autorima i izvorima slika, količina podataka u crtežu bila bi prevelika za vraćanje. Vaš prethodni crtež i podaci o autorima i izvorima slika su zadržani."
entries.reason: The conditional explanation ties excessive size to attribution data in the drawing rather than pixel dimensions. It explicitly preserves the previous drawing and attribution data, not the attempted new edit.

entries.original_xml_text: "Neke sačuvane podatke o autorima i izvorima slika nije moguće pročitati. Njihove sačuvane kopije su zadržane."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Neke sačuvane podatke o autorima i izvorima slika nije moguće pročitati. Njihove sačuvane kopije su zadržane."
entries.reason: Only some saved attribution records are unreadable, and their stored copies remain retained. This neither asserts that all records were lost nor that the unreadable copies are usable.

entries.original_xml_text: "Odredišnu datoteku nije bilo moguće zameniti gotovom slikom."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Odredišnu datoteku nije bilo moguće zameniti gotovom slikom."
entries.reason: The completed image could not replace the destination file. This matches temporary-output rename failure and does not falsely claim a successful provider write.

entries.original_xml_text: "Slika i baferi za kodiranje premašuju ograničenje memorije za izvoz."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Slika i baferi za kodiranje premašuju ograničenje memorije za izvoz."
entries.reason: The image together with encoding buffers exceeds the export memory limit. The complete value neither reduces the demand to the image alone nor confuses it with disk space.

entries.original_xml_text: "Otvaranje slike nije uspelo"
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Otvaranje slike nije uspelo"
entries.reason: Opening the image failed. The unpunctuated prefix is ready for the caller-provided period, space and exception detail, without inventing a format token.

entries.original_xml_text: "Čuvanje slike nije uspelo"
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Čuvanje slike nije uspelo"
entries.reason: Saving the image failed. The value intentionally has no final punctuation or new placeholder because ioFailed appends its own sentence separator and error detail.

entries.original_xml_text: "Izvezena datoteka je napravljena. Pre nego što nastavite, koristite „Sačuvaj“ ili „Sačuvaj kao…“ da sačuvate trenutnu sliku."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Izvezena datoteka je napravljena. Pre nego što nastavite, koristite „Sačuvaj“ ili „Sačuvaj kao…“ da sačuvate trenutnu sliku."
entries.reason: The export file was successfully created, but explicit Save or Save as is still required for the current image before continuing. Both inherited action labels are recognizable and export success is not confused with clearing dirty state.

entries.original_xml_text: "Izvezite ikonu, Base64 tekst ili ASCII crtež. Izvoz ne menja trenutnu sliku niti njeno odredište za opciju „Sačuvaj“."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Izvezite ikonu, Base64 tekst ili ASCII crtež. Izvoz ne menja trenutnu sliku niti njeno odredište za opciju „Sačuvaj“."
entries.reason: The explanation offers the three derived outputs and uses a neither/nor construction to leave both current image and its Save destination unchanged. It describes ASCII art as a drawing and does not claim that exporting writes no output file or saves pending drawing changes.
qualifications: The inherited ASCII option label remains „ASCII sličica“; „ASCII crtež“ describes the same textual visual rendition in this explanation. The existing option label is not changed or reaccepted.

entries.original_xml_text: "Nema dovoljno memorije za čuvanje u ovom formatu. Pokušajte sa PNG formatom"
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Nema dovoljno memorije za čuvanje u ovom formatu. Pokušajte sa PNG formatom"
entries.reason: The selected-format save lacks memory and PNG is suggested as a retry, not guaranteed to fit. No terminal period is added before caller-supplied failure details.

entries.original_xml_text: "PNG kodiranje nije uspelo."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "PNG kodiranje nije uspelo."
entries.reason: PNG encoding failed, matching the false compress-result branch. The sentence does not report saving or completion.

entries.original_xml_text: "Sačuvaj i podeli"
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Sačuvaj i podeli"
entries.reason: The dialog title matches the inherited Save and share menu action without its ellipsis. It is an action label, not a claim that sharing or explicit drawing Save has already succeeded.

entries.original_xml_text: "Izaberite format slike i podešavanja kompresije. Opcija „Sačuvaj“ će ponovo koristiti ovaj naziv datoteke, lokaciju, format i podešavanja."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Izaberite format slike i podešavanja kompresije. Opcija „Sačuvaj“ će ponovo koristiti ovaj naziv datoteke, lokaciju, format i podešavanja."
entries.reason: The user chooses image format and compression settings; later Save reuses all four required items: filename, location, format and settings. The inherited Save command is quoted and there is no claim that compression must be lossy.
qualifications: The underlying inherited format-field label is outside this missing-P0 patch; it is not newly accepted by this prose review.

entries.original_xml_text: "Sačuvano: %1$s"
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Sačuvano: %1$s"
entries.reason: The neutral saved-status word followed by a colon and filename reports the named output only. This remains true for Save, Export and Share writes without claiming that all current document changes are saved.
qualifications: This toast is also used after Export and Share writes; those do not clear the drawing dirty state or alter its ordinary Save target.

entries.original_xml_text: "Kodiranje nije dovršeno."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Kodiranje nije dovršeno."
entries.reason: The incomplete operation is encoding itself, avoiding ambiguity with a human programmer. The negative completion result matches each encoder-failure consumer.

entries.original_xml_text: "Slika je sačuvana, ali Android nije mogao da pokrene deljenje: %1$s"
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Slika je sačuvana, ali Android nije mogao da pokrene deljenje: %1$s"
entries.reason: A successful image write is contrasted with Android failing to launch sharing. The exception-detail token remains separate; the sentence does not erase the successful write or imply the drawing Save target changed.
qualifications: The %1$s exception text may remain untranslated and may itself contain punctuation or percent signs.

entries.original_xml_text: "Nije moguće upisivati na izabranu lokaciju."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Nije moguće upisivati na izabranu lokaciju."
entries.reason: Writing is not possible at the selected location, without guessing permissions, write protection or a specific provider cause.

entries.original_xml_text: "Nije moguće upisivati na ovu lokaciju."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Nije moguće upisivati na ovu lokaciju."
entries.reason: Writing is not possible at this location. The generic wording fits both recovery-ZIP and source-archive export without changing their identities or blaming a narrower cause.

entries.original_xml_text: "Vaša trenutna slika ima nesačuvane izmene."
entries.accepted_xml_text: "Vaša trenutna slika ima nesačuvane izmene."
entries.reason: The current image explicitly has unsaved changes. The negation remains attached to saved state, appropriate to the replacement guard rather than the previous-draft recovery flow.
